dedupe_keys.name: aerocentral airside infrastructure and operations saas transoft solutions

description: AeroCENTRAL is a software-as-a-service platform from Transoft Solutions for sharing airside infrastructure and operational information in one central system. Contents: hosted applications for operational and technical planning; the first two are Stand Guide, which publishes aircraft parking stand configurations, equipment locations and turnaround procedures, and Specifications, a database of aeroplane and helicopter characteristics and dimensions. Users combine their own data with these, for example stand layouts planned in Transoft's AviPLAN, turnaround routes or stand equipment, and can connect external GIS databases, Airport Operational Databases and Safety Management Systems. Coverage: airports, airlines and ground service providers anywhere. Format and access: a scalable web platform; quotes on request. Licence and cost: proprietary; price on request. Caveats: vendor page only; the aircraft database content was not inspected. Its stand and aircraft dimension data help prepare inputs for airport capacity planning and digital twins of the airside, such as checking which stands remain usable when parts of an apron close. It relates to Transoft's AirTOP simulator in the catalogue.
